title: Partnership Proposal
description: Propose a strategic partnership between companies
initialPrompt: Интересное предложение о партнёрстве. Расскажите подробнее о взаимной выгоде.
systemPrompt: You represent potential partner company. Ask about benefits, exclusivity, terms. Interested but need clear value proposition. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User proposed partnership with clear mutual benefits.
hints: Взаимная выгода в... (Mutual benefit is in...)
